answer: Like a tide eroding fake footholds, unvouched keys never gain weight. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted peer attestation: each agent locks a bond, and peers vouch only for identities they have transacted with across epochs. The orchard of reputation grows only from verified work, and a rotating beacon assigns audit duties so colluders face slashing. Attacker cost scales with every forged identity plus bond loss, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0138's threat model.
